title_zh: 央行注销吉林一家公司的支付牌照，今年已有10张
title_en: The central bank cancels a Jilin company's payment licence — 10 cancelled so far this year

paragraphs.zh: 据移动支付网11月20日报道，中国人民银行（央行）在11月12日注销了吉林通卡支付公司的《支付业务许可证》，也就是大家常说的支付牌照。这家公司一般被简称为“吉林通”。
paragraphs.en: According to a November 20 report by Mpaypass, the People's Bank of China (the central bank) cancelled the Payment Business Licence of Jilin Tongka Payment Company on November 12 — what people usually call a payment licence. The company is usually known by the short name "Jilin Tong".

paragraphs.zh: 吉林通成立于2004年，2012年拿到支付牌照，是吉林省里唯一有这种牌照的第三方支付公司。它发行的卡主要用在公共交通上。
paragraphs.en: Jilin Tong was founded in 2004 and got its payment licence in 2012. It was the only third-party payment company in Jilin Province with this kind of licence. The cards it issued were mainly used on public transport.

paragraphs.zh: 预付卡就是先把钱存进卡里，以后再用卡付款。多用途预付卡可以在很多不同的商户使用，单用途预付卡一般只能在一家公司使用。从2025年12月31日起，吉林通已经停止了多用途预付卡业务，所以现在它的卡不能再到合作商户那里买东西，只能用来坐公交。
paragraphs.en: A prepaid card means you first put money onto the card and then pay with the card later. A multi-purpose prepaid card can be used at many different merchants, while a single-purpose prepaid card can usually only be used at one company. Since December 31, 2025, Jilin Tong has stopped its multi-purpose prepaid card business, so its cards can no longer be used to buy things at partner merchants — they can only be used to ride public transport.

paragraphs.zh: 移动支付网统计，今年央行一共注销了10张支付牌照。到现在为止，被注销的支付牌照一共有118张。
paragraphs.en: According to Mpaypass's count, the central bank has cancelled 10 payment licences in total this year. Up to now, 118 payment licences have been cancelled altogether.

vocab.en: central bank (short for 中央银行; here the People's Bank of China)
to cancel, to revoke (a licence or registration)
licence (official permit to run a business)
to be called for short; short name
to cooperate; partner (as in 合作商户)
to count, to compile statistics; statistics

featured.en: licence (an official permit to run a regulated business)
featured.note: In fintech news, 支付牌照 = payment licence. Common verbs: 拿到/获得牌照 (get a licence)、注销牌照 (cancel a licence)、申请牌照 (apply for a licence)、持牌机构 (licensed institution).

examples.zh: 这家公司去年拿到了支付牌照，开始给商户提供收款服务。
examples.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī qùnián nádào le zhīfù páizhào, kāishǐ gěi shānghù tígōng shōukuǎn fúwù.
examples.en: This company got a payment licence last year and started providing payment-collection services to merchants.

examples.zh: 没有牌照的公司不能做支付业务。
examples.py: Méiyǒu páizhào de gōngsī bù néng zuò zhīfù yèwù.
examples.en: A company without a licence cannot run a payment business.

examples.zh: 我朋友想开出租车，先要去办一张牌照。
examples.py: Wǒ péngyou xiǎng kāi chūzūchē, xiān yào qù bàn yì zhāng páizhào.
examples.en: My friend wants to drive a taxi, so first they have to get a licence.

featured.en: third-party payment (payments handled by a non-bank company)
featured.note: Refers to non-bank payment companies such as 支付宝 and 微信支付 (财付通). Often seen as 第三方支付机构 (third-party payment institution)、第三方支付平台、第三方支付市场.

examples.zh: 在中国，很多人用第三方支付平台买东西。
examples.py: Zài Zhōngguó, hěn duō rén yòng dì-sān fāng zhīfù píngtái mǎi dōngxi.
examples.en: In China, many people use third-party payment platforms to buy things.

examples.zh: 我们分析了上个月客户通过第三方支付付款的比例。
examples.py: Wǒmen fēnxī le shàng ge yuè kèhù tōngguò dì-sān fāng zhīfù fùkuǎn de bǐlì.
examples.en: We analysed the share of customers who paid through third-party payment last month.

examples.zh: 这家小饭馆只能用现金，不支持第三方支付。
examples.py: Zhè jiā xiǎo fànguǎn zhǐ néng yòng xiànjīn, bù zhīchí dì-sān fāng zhīfù.
examples.en: This small restaurant only takes cash and doesn't support third-party payment.
